subject: Stopgap safeguard activation for AetherHealth cluster — short maintenance window
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
To: Michael Chen <michael.chen@aetherhealth.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Jan 2028 08:02:00 +0000
Subject: Stopgap safeguard activation for AetherHealth cluster — short maintenance window

Hi Michael —

We observed an unusual tokenization fallback pattern affecting a small percentage (~2%) of requests routed to your dedicated pool this morning. The behavior can cause truncated output on edge-case prompts. Our SREs identified a low-risk mitigation: a small stopgap patch that adjusts tokenizer fallthrough checks and flips a runtime circuit-breaker for the short term.

Plan (short notice):
- Start: 2028-01-14 08:20 UTC
- Expected impact: a rolling restart of service workers per node, 3–7 minutes of reduced throughput (no more than ~5% of requests affected at peak), automatic routing to warm fallback nodes.
- Rollback: full rollback script available; we keep a snapshot and can revert within 5 minutes.

Attachments: stopgap_release_notes_v1.pdf (release notes), stopgap_patch_v1.patch (patch diff)

As this is a safety stopgap, we need your sign-off to proceed. If we don’t hear back by 08:18 UTC we will hold and follow the accelerated on-call escalation. Please confirm whether AetherHealth approves a short maintenance window.

Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Incident Response Lead | Redwood Inference
sofia@redwood.com

From: Michael Chen <michael.chen@aetherhealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@aetherhealth.com
Date: Sun, 14 Jan 2028 08:10:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Stopgap safeguard activation for AetherHealth cluster — short maintenance window

Thanks Sofia —

Appreciate the heads up. We approve the stopgap patch and the 08:20 UTC window. One ask: please confirm the rollback plan and provide a single point of contact during the window (we'll have our on-call infra engineer standing by).

Michael Chen
Director of Platform Engineering | AetherHealth
michael.chen@aetherhealth.com

From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Michael Chen <michael.chen@aetherhealth.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Jan 2028 08:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Stopgap safeguard activation for AetherHealth cluster — short maintenance window

Hi Michael —

Quick technical note and rollback details: we will perform a rolling patch that flips the tokenizer fallthrough guard and cycles workers one node at a time. The rollback is an automated playbook that reapplies the previous runtime image and clears prefix caches; it takes ~4 minutes end-to-end and includes health-check gating.

Runbook links:
- Stopgap activation: https://redwood.app/runbooks/stopgap-activation-2028-01-14
- Rollback playbook (automated): HS-49217

SPOC during maintenance: Connor O'Brien (connor@redwood.com), mobile +1-415-555-0187. Monica will monitor customer-facing telemetry and quota impacts.

Connor
Connor O'Brien
Senior SRE, Runtime Operations | Redwood Inference
connor@redwood.com

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
To: Michael Chen <michael.chen@aetherhealth.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Jan 2028 08:36:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Stopgap safeguard activation for AetherHealth cluster — short maintenance window

On Sun, Jan 14, 2028 at 08:02 AM Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com> wrote:
> We observed an unusual tokenization fallback pattern affecting a small percentage (~2%) of requests routed to your dedicated pool this morning...

PATCH APPLIED — 08:24 UTC
- We executed the stopgap patch at 08:20 UTC and rolled workers in the AetherHealth pool. Observed brief capacity dip consistent with the pre-brief (3–6 minutes per node rolling).
- Post-patch quick checks: tokenization error rate down to 0.1% (from ~2%), median latency unchanged, error-rate spike cleared for verified prompt set.

Please verify on your side when convenient. We will follow up with a short postmortem and a timeline for a fully vetted permanent fix (target: next minor release).

Attachments: stopgap_release_notes_v1.pdf

Thanks —
Sofia

From: Michael Chen <michael.chen@aetherhealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@aetherhealth.com
Date: Sun, 14 Jan 2028 09:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Stopgap safeguard activation for AetherHealth cluster — short maintenance window

Thanks team —

We verified on our side: earlier truncation behavior has stopped for the representative traffic we checked. Appreciate the quick action and the rollback safety. Michael here — please include our compliance lead on the postmortem (I’ll loop them in). Also would like a brief note on whether this stopgap has any billing or quota implications.

Michael
